summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned Kubernetes wizard (/kubernetes). All 4 steps, stepper navigation, wizard-next/back, tag KV editors (sg/inst/vol), node cards (with presets and add/remove), review summary, generate (JSON + HCL), save/load/delete via header dropdown all work end-to-end. Round-trip persistence verified: created cluster with extra TEST_KEY tag and TEST_worker99 node -> reloaded from dropdown -> tags and nodes preserved -> deleted via UI -> removed from dropdown. Backend was not re-tested per instructions.

issues: 'Cluster created' sonner toast overlays the header cluster-select dropdown and blocks pointer events until it dismisses (~4s). Minor UX concern but not blocking; consider positioning toasts away from interactive header controls.

critical_code_review_comments: Kubernetes.jsx (477 lines) is nearing the 700-line soft cap but still readable; consider extracting KVEditor, StepTitle, TagCard, PresetBtn, Summary into /components for reuse.
Toast placement (top-right) overlaps header actions area; consider moving to bottom or increasing z-index margin.
Minor: onValueChange fires when opening the Select even if the user cancels; loadCluster('new') resets step to 0 and clears result which is expected but may surprise users mid-wizard.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST-wizard-<ts> cluster during testing; verified via API GET /api/k8s/clusters that no TEST_* residue remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kubernetes wizard is fully functional. Selectors used: cluster-select, save-cluster-button, delete-cluster-button, confirm-delete-cluster, wizard-next, wizard-back, step-{basics|tags|nodes|review}, k8s-name/region/key/ami/vpc/subnet/zone, k8s-sg/inst/vol with -add and -key-{i}/-val-{i}, node-card-{i}, node-hostname-{i}, node-type-{i}, node-size-{i}, add-node-button, k8s-generate-button, k8s-tab-json, k8s-tab-hcl. Tip: wait ~4s after save before clicking cluster-select because the success toast overlays it.
